implementation_commits.subject: coopmwm planner-eval: dry paired harness, sealed receipts and CPU tests
coopmwm planner-eval: group/sample budgets, paired RNG and JSON-safe CIs

coverage: Strict registration, unique seeds, normalized hashes, planner and analysis settings
Identical world and auxiliary noise seeds in both arms; complete job pairing
Full-episode SUMO quote and separately qualified multi-group/multi-sample WM quote
Signed receipt schema, complete safety counters, finite values, registered job binding
Multi-group decision traces, calibrated probability threshold, 1..4 unique members, full horizon
Per-world collision/teleport constraints and combined TTC/hard-braking gate
Paired whole-world bootstrap confidence intervals, known effects and null effects
Missing/duplicate/foreign receipts and rehashed-but-inconsistent metadata refused
Zero-delay outcomes use JSON null for undefined percentages; safety CIs have no divide-by-zero warnings
Forbidden input/output paths and resolved aliases refused before reading
Dry output overwrite refusal, one registration read, zero simulation charge

dry_run.fixture_kind: Synthetic CPU smoke registration; no evaluation seed registry was read
dry_run.artifact_note: Smoke inputs and generated artifacts are local worktree outputs; implementation and this receipt are tracked.

planning: jobs(plan) -> list of dry world-by-arm job specs
budget_quote(n_worlds, k_candidates=None, episode_end_s=1200, decision_interval_s=60, lookahead_s=300, wm_samples=None, groups_per_decision=None) -> quote
dry_harness: dry_run(registration_path, out_dir) -> summary, writes plan and JSONL jobs
cli: python -m tools.coopmwm.planner_eval quote --worlds N --k-candidates K --wm-samples M --groups-per-decision G

registration_contract.worlds: At least two unique positive integer seed objects. Optional demand/penetration metadata must be present on every world if used.

optional_planner_keys.k_candidates: Positive integer; quoted rollouts also include the none comparator

registration_contract.optional_calibration: Object with path and lowercase 64-character sha256. Reference only: no calibration artifact is opened by this harness.
registration_contract.seed_source: Only the registration file explicitly passed by the caller

analysis_contract.contrast: PLANNER minus MAPPO; negative means improved delay
analysis_contract.bootstrap: 10000 paired whole-world resamples, numpy default_rng(20261101), percentile 95% CI and two-sided CI-inversion p
analysis_contract.completeness: Every registered world x arm exactly once, with signed receipts bound to the generated jobs
analysis_contract.safety_gate: Per world: collisions and teleports must not increase; hard_brake plus ttc_below_1p5_events must not increase. Each counter also receives a descriptive paired CI.
analysis_contract.hash_interoperability: Canonical SHA-256 sealing interoperates with exact_grade.verify_sealed

later_operator_inputs: Supply the actual registration file; the included local smoke fixture is synthetic.
Pin the T1C calibration path and sha256 for the planned PLANNER arm.
Register candidate/sample/group counts for a complete WM rollout quote. Without all three, the total WM quote is explicitly unknown.
Execution belongs to a later separately authorized executor; this module only builds, quotes, validates receipts and analyzes them.
